description: Wait for one named hub event using a saved identity and return it: the first eventName the hub sends once the connection is made, or a timeout error after timeoutMs. sessionId, requestId and context narrow it to events carrying the same values. Listens only: it opens the connection and sends the hub no message, so it changes nothing.

configPath.description: Path to a Thalovant SDK config file.

eventName.description: The bus message type to wait for, such as speak or recognizer_loop:utterance.

fromEnv.description: Load the identity from Thalovant SDK environment variables.

identityFile.description: Path to a Thalovant identity JSON file.

name: thalovant_wait_for_event
title: Wait For Event
